label: C2 from R1 and De ente's receiver reading (inference)
rule: Instantiate R1 and De ente at each contingent being; first disjunct
meaning: A contingent being receives its esse in some principle (R1); by De ente's reading that principle is in receptive potency to its esse; so the being is existentially receptive, the first disjunct of C2. Shows that C2 is weaker than R1 (given De ente).
